Situation — last 30 minutes

  • West Bank — Jalud outpost: IDF evacuated yesterday an illegal Israeli outpost in Area B inside a closed military area near the village of Jalud. A structure with Israeli equipment caught fire. IDF spokesperson: "Yesterday (Sat), IDF forces jumped to the area near Jalud in the Samaria Brigade following detection" (report truncated).
  • West Bank — movement restrictions: IDF imposed an overnight closure on the West Bank. From tomorrow (Sun) until Monday, Palestinian workers will be barred from entering settlements in Judea and Samaria and the Jordan Valley, except for industrial zones and a few approved areas.

Bottom line: Insufficient evidence to assess the trend.

  • יהודה ושומרון — מאחז ג'אלוד: צה"ל פינה אתמול מאחז ישראלי בלתי חוקי באזור B בשטח צבאי סגור ליד הכפר ג'אלוד. מבנה עם ציוד ישראלי עלה באש. דובר צה"ל: "אתמול (ש'), כוחות צה"ל קפצו למרחב הסמוך לכפר ג'אלוד בחטיבת שומרון בעקבות זיהוי" (דיווח מקוטע).
  • יהודה ושומרון — הגבלות תנועה: צה"ל הטיל סגר לילה על איו"ש. החל ממחר (א׳) ועד יום ב' לא תתאפשר כניסת פועלים פלסטינים לעבודות ביישובים ביהודה ושומרון ובבקעה, למעט אזורי תעשייה ואזורים בודדים שאושרו.

מסקנה: עדויות בלתי מספקות כדי להעריך מגמה.

Situation Report — last 2 hours

  • Strike reported: Secret Iranian shipment destroyed in Iraq; Iraqi sources point finger at Israel (Maariv).
  • US military movements: Reports of US warships in the Arabian Sea being restocked with long-range missiles and bunker-buster bombs and two US carrier strike groups deployed near Iran (beholdisraelchannel).
  • Iranian threats: Iran publicly threatened Israel again, publishing a map of targets. Iran’s Ebrahim Azizi warned against moves affecting Iran's national security; media report Iran signals expanded targets with “zero red lines.”
  • West Bank operations: IDF evacuated an illegal Israeli outpost near the village of Jalud in a closed military area; a building with Israeli equipment burned during the operation (AbuAliExpress — duplicate reports).
  • Movement restrictions: IDF announced a closure on Judea & Samaria. From Monday until Tuesday Palestinian workers will be barred from entering settlements, except industrial zones and a few approved areas.
  • Readiness: Media report a large IDF exercise simulating multi-theater attack and infiltration into settlements (Maariv).
  • Other media items: International coverage on Israel’s footprint in Cyprus and online election warfare (Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, EU Defense) — informational only.
  • Threat trend: Rising — concurrent Iranian threats, a reported US military buildup around Iran, and Israeli security measures indicate increased escalation risk.
  • 🟢 Good News: Reported destruction of the Iranian shipment in Iraq.

  • איומי איראן: איראן חידשה אזהרות נגד ישראל, פרסמה מפה עם יעדים; אבראהים עזיזי הזהיר מפני צעדים הפוגעים בביטחון הלאומי של איראן; דיווחים על מדיניות "אפס קווים אדומים" ליעדים עולמיים.
  • פעילות ביהודה ושומרון: צה"ל פינה מאחז בלתי חוקי בקרבת כפר ג'אלוד באזור צבאי סגור; מבנה עם ציוד ישראלי עלה באש במהלך הפעולה (AbuAliExpress).
  • הגבלות תנועה: צה"ל הטיל סגר על יהודה ושומרון — ממחר ועד יום ב' לא תתאפשר כניסת פועלים פלסטינים ליישובים, למעט אזורי תעשייה ואזורים בודדים שאושרו.
  • מוכנות: דיווח על תרגיל צה"ל גדול למענה למתקפה רב-זירתית ולפלישה ליישובים (מעריב).
  • אחר: סיקור עולמי על נוכחות ישראל בקפריסין ומאבקי מידע בבחירות (Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, EU Defense) — בעיקר רקע תקשורתי.
  • מגמת איום: בעלייה — האזהרות האיראניות, הדיווחים על העמסת כוחות אמריקאים וסימני היערכות ישראליים מצביעים על סיכון להסלמה מוגבר.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: דיווח על השמדת המשלוח הסודי מאיראן בעיראק.

  • Iranian threats & targeting
    • Iran renewed threats against Israel with a published map of targets inside Israel (beholdisraelchannel).
    • Media reporting that Iran has defined new, broad target sets “worldwide” (Maariv headline).

    • IDF evacuated an illegal Israeli outpost near the village of Jalud; a structure with Israeli equipment was set on fire during the operation (local report).
    • IDF imposed a temporary closure on parts of the West Bank: Palestinian workers barred from entering most settlements from Sunday through Monday, with limited exceptions for industry zones (IDF statement).
  • Exercises
    • Reports of a large IDF exercise focused on multi-theater response and defense of settlements (Maariv).
  • Other notable items
    • Press pieces and commentary on strategic implications and politics appeared across outlets; no unilateral diplomatic moves or new sanctions reported in these events.
  • Threat trend: Escalating — multiple regional strikes, renewed Iranian targeting messages, and major US naval resupply reported.
  • 🟢 Good News: Saudi-led forces successfully intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile over Riyadh. US forces are restocking naval strike capabilities in the Arabian Sea.

  • Active strikes / interceptions
    • Saudi-led coalition shot down a Houthi ballistic missile over Riyadh.
    • Drone attacks reported on a camp of Iranian Kurdish opposition in Erbil, Iraq.
  • Israel / West Bank
    • IDF evacuated an illegal Israeli outpost near the village of Jalud; a structure with Israeli equipment caught fire during the operation.

    • Saudi-led coalition statements and actions consistent with active defense against Houthi strikes.
  • Diplomatic / political signals
    • US leadership signalled possible resumption of strikes against Iran if negotiations fail.
    • Iran’s judiciary chief reportedly to meet Supreme Leader; Iran urged European states to examine root causes of the conflict (media reports).
    • Israeli and Greek navies conducted drills in the Mediterranean.
  • Threat trend
    • Regional escalation evident: increased military deployments, Houthi targeting, drone strikes, and explicit threats. Increased risk of further strikes and multi-front actions.
  • 🟢 Good News: Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile over Riyadh.

  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: יירוט מוצלח של טיל בליסטי שנורה על ריאד.

Situation Report — Iran–Israel–US (last 48 hours)

  • Active strikes / intercepts
    • Saudi-led coalition shot down a Houthi ballistic missile over Riyadh.
    • A drone strike hit a camp of the Iranian Kurdish opposition (PKK) in Erbil, Iraq.
    • Houthis declared King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh a military target and renewed warnings to airlines.

    • Reports of a major US maritime buildup around Iran: warships being restocked with long-range missiles and bunker-busters; two carrier strike groups reported in the area.
    • US president signaled he may resume strikes against Iran if no deal is reached.
    • Israeli and Greek navies conducted drills in the Mediterranean.
  • Regional political/military signals
    • Iran issued renewed threats toward Israel, accompanied by a map of targets.
    • Reports of a blackout on Iran’s Kish Island.
    • Iran’s judiciary chief reportedly met with Supreme Leader Khamenei.
  • Israeli domestic security measures
    • Following a terror attack that killed two IDF soldiers, security forces launched a targeted operation in the Hebron area.
    • IDF evacuated an unauthorized Israeli outpost near the West Bank village of Jalud; a structure with Israeli equipment burned.
    • Military closure imposed on the West Bank: from Sunday until Monday entry of Palestinian workers into West Bank communities will be restricted, except for approved industrial zones and limited exceptions.
  • Threat trend — Escalating. Multiple strikes, threats, and international military buildup indicate rising tension.
  • 🟢 Good News: Coalition forces successfully intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile over Riyadh.
